purpose: Methodological example of selective outcome observation across development, recalibration and evaluation; not a clinical deployment model
source: INSPIRE; 33394 eligible and 24872 observed; dataset-specific CTS/OG department exclusions plus procedure flags
target: MOVER 2022; 2587 eligible and 2033 observed; post-exploration temporally held-out evaluation, not unseen confirmation
supportive: VitalDB observed cohort only; not independent validation
outcome: Creatinine-defined postoperative AKI; selective testing, release representation and incomplete surveillance remain limitations
clinical_use: Not for diagnosis, triage, treatment choice or clinical deployment
missing_outcomes: Unknown outcomes are not coded as non-events; inference depends on MAR/positivity/nuisance-model assumptions or explicit MNAR scenarios
clinical_validation: No prospective silent evaluation or intervention evaluation; no thresholds recommended
archive: Research-software version 3.3.0 contains the corrected result artifacts; v3.2.5 remains historical.
